8. High-Intensity Interval Training (HIIT): HIIT involves short bursts of high-intensity exercise followed by brief periods of rest. This type of exercise can help improve lung capacity by increasing your endurance and strength.
9. Steady-State Cardio: Engage in steady-state cardio exercises like jogging, cycling, or swimming for at least 30 minutes a day. These exercises can help improve lung capacity by increasing your endurance and strength.
10. Proper Sleep: Getting enough sleep is essential for lung health. Aim for 7-8 hours of sleep each night to help improve lung capacity.
11. Avoid Smoking and Secondhand Smoke: Smoking and secondhand smoke can damage your lungs and reduce lung capacity. Quit smoking and avoid exposure to secondhand smoke to protect your lungs.

14. Try Breathing Exercises with a Balloon: Practice breathing exercises with a balloon to help improve lung capacity. Inhale and exhale slowly through the balloon, feeling the balloon expand and contract with your breath.
15. Practice Breathing Exercises with a Straw: Practice breathing exercises with a straw to help improve lung capacity. Inhale and exhale slowly through the straw, feeling the straw expand and contract with your breath.
